articles.title_en: Assets power solar and battery uptake in Kenya
articles.title_cn: 资产推动肯尼亚太阳能和电池的采用
articles.abstract_en: Solar and battery adoption for households offers many benefits that motivate increased understanding of what drives investment. This paper uses microdata from a household survey in Kenya to investigate factors explaining investment in solar home systems, solar lighting systems, solar lanterns, and solar batteries. Key findings highlight the importance of assets for each investment type. Households are more likely to have a solar home system when they have bank or mobile money accounts, and when they own land with large values. Households are less likely to adopt solar systems when they are unable to afford grid connection, compared to households who are far away from electricity grids. Interaction analysis reveals that off-grid households without a mobile money account in key disadvantaged counties have lower solar home system adoption. A key policy implication is that support could be targeted to households with low levels of assets, in addition to existing support for suppliers.
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭采用太阳能和电池带来了许多好处，这促使人们更加理解驱动投资的因素。本文利用肯尼亚家庭调查的微观数据，研究解释家庭太阳能系统、太阳能照明系统、太阳能灯和太阳能电池投资的因素。主要发现强调了资产对每种投资类型的重要性。当家庭拥有银行或移动货币账户，以及拥有价值较高的土地时，他们更可能拥有太阳能家庭系统。与远离电网的家庭相比，无法负担电网连接的家庭采用太阳能系统的可能性较低。交互分析显示，在关键贫困县，没有移动货币账户的离网家庭太阳能家庭系统采用率较低。一个关键的政策含义是，除了对供应商的现有支持外，支持可以针对资产水平较低的家庭。

articles.title_en: The relative response of Russian National Wealth Fund to oil demand, supply and risk shocks
articles.title_cn: 俄罗斯国家财富基金对石油需求、供给和风险冲击的相对响应
articles.abstract_en: The current economic and political environment requires a rapid government response in managing the external and internal effects of economic shocks. Russian economy substantially relies on hydrocarbon revenue, thus the government formed National Wealth Fund (NWF) as a macroprudential instrument to mitigate the adverse effect of the global energy market. To this end, we utilise the Cross-Quantilogram framework to analyse the response of the NWF to Oil Demand, Supply and Risk Shocks ranging from 13 July 2012 until 30 June 2022. To decompose oil market shocks, we follow the new Ready (2018) identification methodology. We also establish the channels of possible responsiveness of NWF to structural oil shocks. Our empirical investigation demonstrates the NWF of Russia is highly anchored with oil market shocks. Specifically, NWF positively responds to Oil Demand Shock at the lower to the median quantiles of demand-side shock and low quantiles of National Wealth Fund. The negative responsiveness of the NWF of Russia to the Oil Supply Shock is profound at the higher quantiles of NWF and the least quantile of a supply shock. Finally, Oil Risk Shock affects negatively to NWF. The robust findings of the study may be used to derive important policy implications for utilising the NWF and regulating Russia's economic stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 当前的经济和政治环境要求政府在管理经济冲击的外部与内部效应时做出快速反应。俄罗斯经济在很大程度上依赖碳氢化合物收入，因此政府设立了国家财富基金（NWF）作为宏观审慎工具，以减轻全球能源市场的不利影响。为此，我们利用交叉分位数图（Cross-Quantilogram）框架，分析了从2012年七月13日至2022年六月30日期间，NWF对石油需求、供给和风险冲击的响应。为分解石油市场冲击，我们遵循Ready（2018）的新识别方法。我们还建立了NWF对结构性石油冲击可能响应的渠道。我们的实证研究表明，俄罗斯的NWF与石油市场冲击高度相关。具体而言，在需求侧冲击的下分位数至中位数以及国家财富基金的低分位数处，NWF对石油需求冲击呈正向响应。俄罗斯NWF对石油供给冲击的负向响应在NWF的高分位数和供给冲击的最低分位数处显著。最后，石油风险冲击对NWF产生负向影响。该研究的稳健发现可用于制定利用NWF和调节俄罗斯经济稳定的重要政策启示。

articles.title_en: Drivers and pass-through of the EU ETS price: Evidence from the power sector
articles.title_cn: 欧盟碳排放交易体系价格的驱动因素与传导：来自电力部门的证据
articles.abstract_en: Despite low and volatile allowance prices observed between 2008 and 2018 within the European Union (EU) Emission Trading System (ETS), power generators’ responses were by and large consistent with predictions of economic theory. We infer this in a number of steps. First by establishing that the qualitative response of the EU ETS allowance price to variations in the pre-eminent drivers of short-term fuel-switching, both the gas and coal price, is as economic theory prescribes. Second, we decompose allowance price returns and impute that allowance banking had value in helping generators smooth compliance costs. Third, we show that pass-through of allowance costs was (more than) complete in seven major European markets for both coal- and gas- fired power generation. Our inference on pass-through is novel in that we impute allowance cost pass-through by dispatch technology even when the merit-order curve is unobserved. Put together, our findings imply that even prior to the recent reform-induced price appreciation, the EU ETS was more functional than many observers recognized.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管在2008年至2018年间，欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）中的配额价格低且波动，但电力生产商的反应大体上与经济学理论的预测一致。我们通过几个步骤推断出这一点。首先，通过确定欧盟ETS配额价格对短期燃料转换的主要驱动因素（即天然气和煤炭价格）变化的定性反应符合经济学理论的规范。其次，我们分解配额价格回报，并推断配额银行在帮助生产商平滑合规成本方面具有价值。第三，我们表明，在七个主要欧洲市场中，无论是燃煤还是燃气发电，配额成本的传导是（超过）完全的。我们对传导的推断是新颖的，因为即使在没有观察到边际成本曲线的情况下，我们也按调度技术推算配额成本传导。综合来看，我们的发现意味着，即使在近期改革引发的价格上涨之前，欧盟ETS的功能也比许多观察者所认识到的更为完善。

articles.title_en: Exquisite workmanship through net-zero emissions? The effects of carbon emission trading policy on firms' export product quality
articles.title_cn: 净零排放下的精湛工艺？碳排放交易政策对企业出口产品质量的影响
articles.abstract_en: China introduced the “Notice on Launch of the Pilot Work of Carbon Emissions Trading” in 2011 as an economic policy to tackle environmental problems and promote high-quality economic development through market mechanisms. Using the DID (difference-in-differences) method, this study examines the impact of this policy on the export product quality of enterprises. To measure the export product quality, we matched Chinese customs import and export data with Chinese A-share listed company data and constructed the requirement residual using the demand information inversion method. Our results show that the carbon emission trading policy has a persistent negative effect on improving the export product quality of enterprises, which varies depending on the characteristics of the enterprise and the external environment. We also found that the policy's implementation is not associated with improvements in enterprise environmental or economic performance. To provide additional analysis, we constructed a regression model of enterprise export product quality on enterprise environmental performance and economic performance. Overall, this study provides insights for policymakers on the variations in export product quality of microcosmic enterprises in response to the carbon emission trading policy, which is critical for achieving net-zero emissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国于2011年出台《关于开展碳排放权交易试点工作的通知》，作为一项通过市场机制解决环境问题、促进经济高质量发展的经济政策。本研究采用双重差分法（DID），考察该政策对企业出口产品质量的影响。为衡量出口产品质量，我们将中国海关进出口数据与中国A股上市公司数据相匹配，并利用需求信息反推法构建了需求残差。结果表明，碳排放交易政策对企业出口产品质量的提升具有持续的负向效应，且该效应因企业特征和外部环境的不同而有所差异。我们还发现，该政策的实施并未带来企业环境绩效或经济绩效的改善。为进一步分析，我们构建了企业出口产品质量对企业环境绩效和经济绩效的回归模型。总体而言，本研究为政策制定者提供了关于微观企业出口产品质量对碳排放交易政策响应的见解，这对于实现净零排放至关重要。

articles.title_en: Diversification effects of China's carbon neutral bond on renewable energy stock markets: A minimum connectedness portfolio approach
articles.title_cn: 中国碳中和债券对可再生能源股票市场的分散化效应：一种最小连通性投资组合方法
articles.abstract_en: Socially responsible investment (SRI) is becoming increasingly popular in China, with the announcement of carbon dioxide peaking by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2060 (30–60 targets). As a conventional underlying asset of SRI, renewable energy stocks are attractive, but with higher price volatility than many other traditional industrial stocks. This paper aims to investigate the interaction and diversification effects of China's Carbon Neutral Bond (CNB), a new SRI underlying asset just launched in 2021, on renewable energy stocks using a novel minimum connectedness portfolio approach recently proposed by Broadstock et al. (2020). The empirical results show that, first, China's CNB is weakly related to renewable energy stocks, whether in the time or frequency domain, and is the main recipient of the net linkage effect. Second, different renewable energy stocks benefit differently from the diversification effect of CNB. However, in extreme market conditions, the diversification effect of the CNB is reduced. Third, the newly developed minimum connectedness portfolio approach can outperform traditional minimum variance and correlation methods by achieving higher cumulative portfolio returns. Finally, the Sharpe ratios of renewable energy stock portfolios with CNB are significantly higher than those without it across different allocation methods. These findings have important implications for policy makers and SRI investors.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会责任投资（SRI）在中国日益流行，随着二氧化碳排放力争于2030年前达到峰值、努力争取2060年前实现碳中和（30-60目标）的宣布。作为SRI的传统标的资产，可再生能源股票具有吸引力，但其价格波动性高于许多其他传统工业股票。本文旨在利用Broadstock等人（2020）最近提出的新颖最小连通性投资组合方法，研究中国碳中和债券（CNB）——一种于2021年刚推出的新型SRI标的资产——对可再生能源股票的交互作用和分散化效应。实证结果表明：第一，无论在时间域还是频率域，中国CNB与可再生能源股票的相关性较弱，并且是净关联效应的主要接收者。第二，不同的可再生能源股票从CNB的分散化效应中获益不同。然而，在极端市场条件下，CNB的分散化效应会减弱。第三，新开发的最小连通性投资组合方法能够通过实现更高的累计投资组合收益，优于传统的方差最小化和相关性方法。最后，在不同配置方法下，包含CNB的可再生能源股票投资组合的夏普比率显著高于不含CNB的投资组合。这些发现对政策制定者和SRI投资者具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Does political inspection promote corporate green innovation?
articles.title_cn: 政治巡视是否促进企业绿色创新？
articles.abstract_en: Green innovation is an effective approach to breaking resource availability and environment protection constraints that firms face. China has set up a political inspection team to fight against corruption and deepen state-owned firm reform in recent years. From 2013 to 2015, inspections, as exogenous events, made great achievements in regulating firm behavior. This regulation may exert an effect on green and innovative development in China. Therefore, we adopt the event of political inspection of state-owned firms as a quasi-natural experiment and examine the impact of such an inspection on firm green innovation using data from listed Chinese state-owned enterprises. Findings show that political inspection enhances corporate green innovation. The effect is more pronounced for firms with higher executive compensation and institutional ownership. Political inspection promotes firm green innovation by alleviating financing constraints and reducing rent-seeking. Our study suggests that political inspection, as an external shock, is key to promoting firm green innovation.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色创新是突破企业面临的资源可得性和环境保护约束的有效途径。近年来，中国设立了政治巡视组，以打击腐败并深化国有企业改革。从2013年到2015年，巡视作为外生事件，在规范企业行为方面取得了巨大成就。这种规范可能对中国的绿色和创新发展产生影响。因此，我们将国有企业政治巡视事件作为准自然实验，利用中国上市国有企业数据，考察此类巡视对企业绿色创新的影响。研究发现，政治巡视增强了企业绿色创新。对于高管薪酬和机构持股较高的企业，这种效应更为显著。政治巡视通过缓解融资约束和减少寻租来促进企业绿色创新。我们的研究表明，政治巡视作为一种外部冲击，是促进企业绿色创新的关键。

articles.title_en: Environmental productivity growth across European industries
articles.title_cn: 欧洲各行业的环境生产率增长
articles.abstract_en: European industries are under pressure regarding their environmental performance and productivity growth. The current energy crisis offsets governments’ efforts to achieve carbon neutrality while removing significant degrees of freedom in terms of firm’s competitiveness. This paper studies environmental productivity and its components at a European industrial level using a dataset of 13 industries of the manufacturing sector from 27 European countries over the 1995–2014 period. Our results point out that industrial environmental productivity has deteriorated across Europe with best practice change being the main contributor. In addition, referring to the technological leaders in Europe, the findings point out that low tend to follow the middle-high technology industries. Finally, the non-convergence hypothesis and the creation of discrete clubs for the productivity index case and its components are supported.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧洲各行业在环境绩效和生产率增长方面面临压力。当前的能源危机抵消了政府实现碳中和的努力，同时在企业竞争力方面减少了显著的自由度。本文利用1995-2014年期间来自27个欧洲国家制造业部门13个行业的数据集，研究了欧洲工业层面的环境生产率及其组成部分。我们的结果表明，欧洲工业环境生产率已经恶化，最佳实践变化是主要贡献因素。此外，参照欧洲的技术领先者，研究结果表明低技术行业倾向于追随中高技术行业。最后，支持非收敛假设以及生产率指数及其组成部分的离散俱乐部形成。

articles.title_en: Tracking economic fluctuations with electricity consumption in Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 利用孟加拉国电力消耗追踪经济波动
articles.abstract_en: This paper establishes electricity consumption as an indicator for tracking economic fluctuations in Bangladesh. It presents monthly data on national electricity consumption since 1993 and subnational daily consumption data since February 2010. Electricity consumption is strongly correlated with other high-frequency indicators of economic activity, and it has declined during natural disasters and the COVID-19 lockdowns. The paper estimates an electricity consumption model that explains over 90% of the variation in daily consumption based on a quadratic trend, seasonality, within-week variation, national holidays, Ramadan, and temperature. Deviations from the model prediction can act as an indicator of subnational economic fluctuations. For example, electricity consumption in Dhaka fell around 40% below normal in April and May 2020 during the first COVID-19 lockdown and remained below normal afterwards. The later lockdowns, in contrast, had much smaller impacts, in line with less stringent containment measures and more effective adaptation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文确立电力消耗作为追踪孟加拉国经济波动的指标。文章提供了自1993年以来的全国月度电力消耗数据以及自2010年二月以来的次国家级每日消耗数据。电力消耗与其他高频经济活动指标密切相关，并且在自然灾害和COVID-19封锁期间有所下降。本文估计了一个电力消耗模型，该模型基于二次趋势、季节性、周内变化、国家假日、斋月和温度，解释了每日消耗变异的90%以上。模型预测的偏差可以作为次国家级经济波动的指标。例如，在2020年四月和五月首次COVID-19封锁期间，达卡的电力消耗比正常水平低约40%，此后仍低于正常水平。相比之下，后来的封锁影响要小得多，这与较不严格的遏制措施和更有效的适应相一致。

articles.title_en: Environmental degradation and economic growth: Investigating linkages and potential pathways
articles.title_cn: 环境退化与经济增长：探究关联性与潜在路径
articles.abstract_en: Concerns about the incessant rise in emissions and their attendant effects on climate change, which is ravaging the globe, are on the ascendency. The literature has almost concluded that economic activities and growth contribute significantly to environmental degradation. Despite the plethora of studies on the effect of economic growth on environmental degradation, empirical studies examining the reverse – i.e., how environmental degradation affects economic growth – are limited. However, the associated literature postulates that attaining economic growth is accompanied by increased environmental degradation. To guide the development of non-conflicting environmental and structural policies, this study examines whether the rise in environmental degradation is associated with economic growth. It also examines the potential channels through which environmental degradation could affect economic growth. Using a global panel comprising 140 countries from 1980 to 2021 and the two-step dynamic system-generalized method of moment technique to control endogeneity, the findings generally indicate a retarding effect of environmental degradation on economic growth. Further analysis, however, reveals that emissions exhibit an inverted U-shaped relationship with economic growth. However, ecological footprint indicators of environmental degradation have a U-shaped relationship with economic growth. Pathway analysis highlighted that health, foreign direct investment, and technological innovation are the potential channels through which environmental degradation could retard economic growth. The policy implications are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 对排放持续上升及其对气候变化（正在肆虐全球）的伴随效应的担忧日益加剧。文献几乎已得出结论，经济活动与增长对环境退化有显著贡献。尽管关于经济增长对环境退化影响的研究众多，但考察反向关系——即环境退化如何影响经济增长——的实证研究却有限。然而，相关文献假设，实现经济增长伴随着环境退化的加剧。为指导制定不冲突的环境与结构性政策，本研究考察环境退化的加剧是否与经济增长相关联，并探究环境退化可能影响经济增长的潜在渠道。利用包含1980年至2021年140个国家的全球面板数据，并采用两步动态系统广义矩方法控制内生性，研究结果总体表明环境退化对经济增长具有抑制作用。然而，进一步分析揭示，排放与经济增长呈倒U型关系。而生态足迹指标所代表的环境退化与经济增长呈U型关系。路径分析强调，健康、外国直接投资和技术创新是环境退化可能抑制经济增长的潜在渠道。本文讨论了政策含义。

articles.title_en: Analysis of generation investments under price controls in cross-border trade of electricity
articles.title_cn: 跨境电力贸易中价格管制下的发电投资分析
articles.abstract_en: Price controls are commonly employed in Latin America and other regions to prevent price increases in exporting regions during cross-border trade of electricity. This paper introduces a methodology to evaluate the economic impact of price controls on generation investments, dispatch decisions, and carbon emissions in the context of cross-border electricity trade. We propose a non-linear adjusting function to represent a price-control rule, which can be incorporated into equilibrium models for generation firms and price-sensitive consumers. By employing fixed-point iterations between the adjusting function and an optimization problem that determines equilibrium investments and dispatch decisions for generation firms in a competitive environment, we obtain an equilibrium solution. We apply the proposed methodology to analyze the current price controls governing cross-border electricity trade between Chile and Argentina, with a focus on the exporting country. Our findings reveal that existing price controls can impede incentives for renewable energy investments, particularly in wind and solar, while stimulating investments in fossil fuel-based generation capacity. Moreover, these controls lead to increased CO 2 emissions compared to a scenario without price controls. Additionally, we observe that the inefficiency resulting from price controls is proportionate to the volume of exports relative to local demand and the price elasticity of demand in the importing region.
articles.abstract_cn: 价格管制在拉丁美洲和其他地区常被用于防止跨境电力贸易中出口地区的价格上涨。本文提出了一种评估价格管制对发电投资、调度决策和碳排放经济影响的方法，适用于跨境电力贸易背景。我们提出一个非线性调整函数来表示价格管制规则，该函数可纳入发电企业和价格敏感型消费者的均衡模型中。通过在调整函数与一个确定竞争环境下发电企业均衡投资和调度决策的优化问题之间采用不动点迭代，我们获得了均衡解。我们将所提出的方法应用于分析智利和阿根廷之间跨境电力贸易的现行价格管制，重点关注出口国。我们的研究结果表明，现有价格管制可能阻碍可再生能源投资激励，尤其是风能和太阳能，同时刺激化石燃料发电能力的投资。此外，与无价格管制情景相比，这些管制导致CO 2排放增加。我们还观察到，价格管制导致的效率损失与出口量相对于当地需求的比例以及进口地区的需求价格弹性成正比。

articles.title_en: EU in search of a Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
articles.title_cn: 欧盟寻求碳边境调节机制
articles.abstract_en: To meet the targets of the EU’s Fit for 55 package, the European Commission proposed in July 2021 to implement a Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) to replace free allocation of Emission Trading System (ETS) allowances for the most trade-exposed emitting industries. CBAM aims to prevent carbon leakage and restore a level playing field in high-emitting industries. Its design, as voted by the European Council in March 2022, by the Parliament in June, and ultimately amended by a provisional agreement between the Council and the European Parliament in December 2022, raises several issues. This paper aims to quantify the economic and environmental impacts of different choices regarding this design. Simulations are based on a dynamic general equilibrium model representing imperfect competition, input–output relations, greenhouse gas emissions, the endogenous price of emission quotas and the presence of free allocation of allowances. We show that CBAM is effective in reducing carbon leakage. But its design increases the price of carbon in the European Emissions Trading Scheme. Competitiveness losses in export markets are expected for downstream sectors that are not covered by the CBAM, as well as for European exporters of high-emitting industries, even in the presence of rebates.
articles.abstract_cn: 为实现欧盟“Fit for 55”一揽子计划的目标，欧盟委员会于2021年七月提议实施碳边境调节机制（CBAM），以取代对贸易暴露度最高的排放行业免费分配排放交易体系（ETS）配额。CBAM旨在防止碳泄漏，并在高排放行业恢复公平竞争环境。其设计在欧洲理事会2022年三月、议会六月的投票中，以及最终由理事会与欧洲议会于2022年十二月达成的临时协议修订后，引发了一些问题。本文旨在量化该设计不同选择的经济和环境影响。模拟基于一个动态一般均衡模型，该模型刻画了不完全竞争、投入产出关系、温室气体排放、排放配额的內生价格以及免费配额分配的存在。我们表明，CBAM在减少碳泄漏方面是有效的。但其设计提高了欧洲排放交易体系中碳的价格。对于未纳入CBAM的下游行业以及高排放行业的欧洲出口商，即使存在退税，其出口市场的竞争力损失也是预期的。

articles.title_en: Optimum combination of heterogeneous environmental policy instruments and market for green transformation: Empirical evidence from China's metal sector
articles.title_cn: 异质性环境政策工具与绿色转型市场的优化组合：来自中国金属行业的经验证据
articles.abstract_en: Based on the new structural economics view that the combination of effective governments and efficient markets is the fundamental path to high-quality development, this study investigates how heterogeneous environmental policy instruments combine with marketization to improve the total factor energy-environmental efficiency (TFEEE) in China's metal sector. Utilizing the provincial panel data from 2006 to 2019, a super-efficiency slacks-based measure data envelopment analysis (SBM-DEA) integrated with the global Malmquist-Luenberger (GML) index is employed to estimate the energy-environmental efficiency and its dynamic changes. The evaluation results imply a significant increasing trend in the energy-environmental efficiency, but the overall level is rather low with disparities between sub-sectors and different regions. Using a dynamic panel threshold model, the “strong” version of the Porter Hypothesis is validated that command-and-control environmental policy (CEP), market-incentive environmental policy (MEP), and voluntary environmental policy (VEP) have an optimum stringency range to induce TFEEE growth, while the impact modes are drastically diverse. Further study verifies that higher marketization is conducive to triggering the facilitation effect of heterogeneous environmental policy instruments on the TFEEE but with completely different threshold values of marketization, which decrease sequentially corresponding to VEP, CEP, and MEP.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于新结构经济学关于有效政府与有效市场相结合是实现高质量发展的根本路径的观点，本研究探讨了异质性环境政策工具如何与市场化相结合以提高中国金属行业的总要素能源环境效率（TFEEE）。利用2006年至2019年的省级面板数据，采用超效率松弛变量测度数据包络分析（SBM-DEA）结合全局Malmquist-Luenberger（GML）指数来估算能源环境效率及其动态变化。评估结果表明能源环境效率呈显著上升趋势，但总体水平较低，且子行业和不同地区之间存在差异。使用动态面板门槛模型，验证了波特假说的“强”版本，即命令控制型环境政策（CEP）、市场激励型环境政策（MEP）和自愿型环境政策（VEP）存在诱导TFEEE增长的最优严格程度范围，而影响模式则截然不同。进一步研究证实，更高的市场化程度有利于触发异质性环境政策工具对TFEEE的促进作用，但市场化的门槛值完全不同，且按VEP、CEP和MEP的顺序依次递减。

articles.title_en: The value of electricity storage arbitrage on day-ahead markets across Europe
articles.title_cn: 欧洲日前市场上电力储存套利的价值
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the historical value of electricity storage from the perspective of the storage owner in day-ahead markets (DAM) across Europe. A technology-neutral formulation is used, where the storage is modelled based on its round-trip efficiency and storage duration. A mixed-integer linear program (MILP) is built to compute the perfect-foresight value of a price-taker storage from arbitrage, using historical hourly DAM prices in all the bidding zones of the EU-28 countries, Norway, Switzerland, and Turkey. Depending on the bidding zones, the DAM price data starts between 2000 and 2017, and spans to 2021. The model is solved for varying round-trip efficiencies (50% to 100%) and storage durations (1 to 10 h) for every bidding zone and every year in the dataset. The results reveal significant variations in storage value from arbitrage, both geographically and temporally, with round-trip efficiency having a major impact on arbitrage value and storage duration having very low marginal value beyond 4 to 6 h. Additionally, the paper investigates the impact of variable grid fees on arbitrage value, using the case of Belgium, where fees depend on storage system size. The initial MILP is therefore augmented to account for the complex dependencies between storage size and the resulting grid fees. The augmented MILP shows that grid fees can decrease storage arbitrage value by 20% to 50%, and that they can also dramatically decrease storage participation in DAMs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文从储存所有者的角度，研究了欧洲日前市场（DAM）中电力储存的历史价值。采用技术中性的表述，储存模型基于其往返效率和储存持续时间。构建了一个混合整数线性规划（MILP），利用欧盟28国、挪威、瑞士和土耳其所有竞价区的历史小时级日前市场价格，计算价格接受者储存通过套利获得的完美预见价值。根据竞价区的不同，日前市场价格数据始于2000年至2017年，并延伸至2021年。该模型针对数据集中的每个竞价区和每一年，以不同的往返效率（50%至100%）和储存持续时间（1至10小时）进行求解。结果揭示了储存套利价值在地理和时间上的显著差异，其中往返效率对套利价值有重大影响，而储存持续时间在4至6小时之后边际价值非常低。此外，本文以比利时为例，研究了可变电网费用对套利价值的影响，该国的费用取决于储存系统规模。因此，初始的MILP被扩展以考虑储存规模与由此产生的电网费用之间的复杂依赖关系。扩展后的MILP表明，电网费用可使储存套利价值降低20%至50%，并且还可能大幅减少储存参与日前市场的程度。

articles.title_en: Soft-linking a national computable general equilibrium model (ThreeME) with a detailed energy system model (IESA-Opt)
articles.title_cn: 将国家可计算一般均衡模型（ThreeME）与详细能源系统模型（IESA-Opt）进行软链接
articles.abstract_en: Top-down CGE models are used to assess the economic impacts of climate change policies. However, these models do not represent the technologies and sources of greenhouse gas emissions as detailed as bottom-up energy system models. Linking a top-down CGE model with a bottom-up energy system model assures macroeconomic consistency while accounting for a detailed representation of energy and emission flows. While there is ample literature regarding the linking process, the corresponding details and underlying assumptions are barely described in detail. The present paper describes a step-by-step soft-linking process and its underlying assumptions, using the Netherlands as a case study. This soft-linking process increases the Dutch energy demand levels in 2050 by 19.5% on average compared to assumed exogenous levels. Moreover, the GDP in 2050 reduces by 5.5% compared to the baseline economic scenario. Furthermore, we identified high energy prices as the primary cause of this GDP reduction in the soft-linking process.
articles.abstract_cn: 自上而下的CGE模型用于评估气候变化政策的经济影响。然而，这些模型对温室气体排放技术和来源的表示不如自下而上的能源系统模型详细。将自上而下的CGE模型与自下而上的能源系统模型链接起来，可以在确保宏观经济一致性的同时，详细表示能源和排放流。尽管关于链接过程的文献很多，但相应的细节和基本假设却很少被详细描述。本文以荷兰为案例研究，描述了逐步软链接过程及其基本假设。与假设的外生水平相比，这种软链接过程使荷兰2050年的能源需求水平平均增加了19.5%。此外，与基线经济情景相比，2050年的GDP减少了5.5%。此外，我们确定高能源价格是软链接过程中GDP减少的主要原因。

articles.title_en: Energy poverty and food insecurity: Is there an energy or food trade-off among low-income Australians?
articles.title_cn: 能源贫困与食品不安全：澳大利亚低收入人群是否存在能源或食品的权衡？
articles.abstract_en: Large price rises can lead to what has been termed a ‘heat or eat’ trade-off, where some low-income individuals must choose between energy use and putting food on the table. Low-income individuals are particularly at risk. There are effects on physical health from either restricted energy use or restricted food intake (in terms of quantity or nutritional value) and there may also be effects on mental health due to stress associated with being unable to pay bills or buy food. Considering escalating energy and food prices, this study investigates the energy or food trade-off among low-income people in Australia. While there is some literature on the heat or eat trade-off, our contribution lies in our use of detailed longitudinal population-representative data and multivariable analysis with a focus on low-income individuals who are most vulnerable. Among all low-income households, a 1% increase in the relative price of electricity increases energy expenditure by 0.44% and reduces food expenditure by 0.09% and these effects are statistically significant. For those in poverty, we find a 1% increase in the relative price of electricity increases energy expenditure by 0.37% but has no significant effect on food expenditure. This is consistent with individuals in poverty having economised as far as possible and being unable to reduce expenditure any further. For those near poverty the increase in price reduces food expenditure by 0.20% although there is no significant effect on energy expenditure, indicating individuals are economising on energy use to offset the price increase. For the remaining low-income individuals, the price increase results in a trade-off in which energy is prioritised over food. Reduced food expenditure, however, does not seem to translate into going without meals.
articles.abstract_cn: 大幅价格上涨可能导致所谓的“取暖或吃饭”权衡，即一些低收入个体必须在能源使用和将食物摆上餐桌之间做出选择。低收入个体尤其面临风险。限制能源使用或限制食物摄入（就数量或营养价值而言）都会对身体健康产生影响，而且由于无力支付账单或购买食物所带来的压力，也可能对心理健康产生影响。考虑到能源和食品价格的不断上涨，本研究调查了澳大利亚低收入人群中的能源或食品权衡问题。虽然关于“取暖或吃饭”权衡的文献已有一些，但我们的贡献在于使用了详细的纵向人口代表性数据和多变量分析，重点关注最脆弱的低收入个体。在所有低收入家庭中，相对电价每上涨1%，能源支出增加0.44%，食品支出减少0.09%，且这些影响在统计上显著。对于贫困人群，我们发现相对电价每上涨1%，能源支出增加0.37%，但对食品支出没有显著影响。这与贫困人群已尽可能节约开支、无法进一步减少支出是一致的。对于接近贫困的人群，价格上涨使食品支出减少0.20%，尽管对能源支出没有显著影响，这表明个体正在节约能源使用以抵消价格上涨。对于其余低收入个体，价格上涨导致了一种权衡，即能源优先于食品。然而，食品支出的减少似乎并未转化为不吃饭。

articles.title_en: What can be learned from the historical trend of crude oil prices? An ensemble approach for crude oil price forecasting
articles.title_cn: 从原油价格的历史趋势中能学到什么？一种集成方法用于原油价格预测
articles.abstract_en: Crude oil price series are nonlinear and highly volatile, making it difficult to obtain satisfactory performance for traditional statistical-based forecasting methods. To improve forecasting accuracy, this study proposes a novel learning paradigm by integrating the trajectory similarity method with machine learning models based on the decomposition-ensemble framework. In the proposed learning paradigm, raw data of international crude oil prices are first decomposed using variational mode decomposition (VMD), after which, using sample entropy (SE), the resulting essential modal functions are divided into high and low frequencies. The process aims to reorganize the data by using the forecasting properties of different models. Finally, to obtain the final forecasting results, two models, i.e., the trajectory similarity method (TS) and long short term memory neural network (LSTM), are applied to predict and sum up the low and high-frequency subseries, respectively. As sample data for validation, this study selected the international crude oil price series of West Texas Intermediate (WTI) and Brent. Experimental results showed that the proposed VMD-SE-TS/LSTM learning paradigm significantly outperforms all other benchmark models, including the single models without decomposition and the hybrid models with decomposition. The proposed approach performs best in different evaluation metrics and statistical tests under different horizons, indicating that the proposed VMD-SE-TS/LSTM learning paradigm is effective and robust in crude oil price forecasting.
articles.abstract_cn: 原油价格序列是非线性和高度波动的，这使得传统的基于统计的预测方法难以获得令人满意的性能。为了提高预测精度，本研究提出了一种新的学习范式，将轨迹相似性方法与基于分解-集成框架的机器学习模型相结合。在所提出的学习范式中，首先使用变分模态分解（VMD）对国际原油价格的原始数据进行分解，然后利用样本熵（SE）将得到的基本模态函数划分为高频和低频。该过程旨在利用不同模型的预测特性来重组数据。最后，为了获得最终的预测结果，分别应用轨迹相似性方法（TS）和长短期记忆神经网络（LSTM）两种模型来预测并汇总低频和高频子序列。作为验证的样本数据，本研究选取了西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）和布伦特原油的国际原油价格序列。实验结果表明，所提出的VMD-SE-TS/LSTM学习范式显著优于所有其他基准模型，包括无分解的单一模型和带分解的混合模型。所提出的方法在不同评估指标和不同时间跨度下的统计检验中表现最佳，表明所提出的VMD-SE-TS/LSTM学习范式在原油价格预测中是有效且稳健的。

articles.title_en: The time-varying effects of liquidity and market efficiency of the European Union carbon market: Evidence from the TVP-SVAR-SV approach
articles.title_cn: 欧盟碳市场流动性与市场效率的时变效应：基于TVP-SVAR-SV方法的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use the time-varying parameter structural vector autoregression stochastic volatility (TVP-SVAR-SV) and causality-in-quantiles methods to explore the linkage between market liquidity and efficiency in the European Union Emissions Trading Scheme (EU ETS) during Phase III. Our findings indicate that two-way causality existed under normal and lower market conditions. Additionally, the linkage between liquidity and efficiency exhibits time-varying characteristics. Except in cases of extremely high market liquidity, the pass-through effect of liquidity on efficiency is mostly positive in the long run. The linkage is particularly stronger in the medium and long term. However, the response of liquidity to efficiency shocks is more complicated. Market efficiency generally has an overall inhibitory effect on liquidity in the short term and a promoting effect in the medium and long term. Furthermore, we investigate the impulse response during the COVID-19 period and the war between Russia and Ukraine and find that improvements in efficiency will permanently damage liquidity. Overall, the abilities of market makers and arbitrage traders, impacted by multiple factors, play an important role in the process by which liquidity affects market efficiency. By revealing and explaining the dynamic relationship between liquidity and efficiency, this research provides valuable information for policymakers and various market participants.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用时变参数结构向量自回归随机波动率（TVP-SVAR-SV）和分位数因果关系方法，探讨欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）第三阶段市场流动性与效率之间的联系。我们的研究结果表明，在正常和较低市场条件下存在双向因果关系。此外，流动性与效率之间的联系表现出时变特征。除市场流动性极高的情况外，流动性对效率的传导效应在长期内大多为正。这种联系在中长期尤为显著。然而，流动性对效率冲击的响应更为复杂。市场效率在短期内总体上对流动性有抑制作用，而在中长期则有促进作用。此外，我们研究了COVID-19期间以及俄罗斯与乌克兰战争期间的脉冲响应，发现效率的改善将永久损害流动性。总体而言，受多种因素影响的做市商和套利交易者的能力，在流动性影响市场效率的过程中发挥着重要作用。通过揭示和解释流动性与效率之间的动态关系，本研究为政策制定者和各类市场参与者提供了有价值的信息。

articles.title_en: Insights from adding transportation sector detail into an economy-wide model: The case of the ADAGE CGE model
articles.title_cn: 在整体经济模型中增加交通部门细节的见解：ADAGE CGE模型的案例
articles.abstract_en: Computable general equilibrium (CGE) models provide valuable insights into economy-wide impacts of anticipated future structural changes in the transportation sector, yet few CGE models offer detailed transportation representations. We use an enhanced Applied Dynamic Analysis of the Global Economy (ADAGE) CGE model to incorporate disaggregated transportation modes and technologies in on-road passenger and freight transportation. We assess the impacts of these inclusions on U.S. transportation patterns, energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. Simulating illustrative global oil price cases with and without transportation detail, we find subsector mode disaggregation and technology additions in a CGE model significantly alter the impacts of oil prices on global trade and freight patterns, energy consumption, and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. We find that: (1) alternative technologies are essential for capturing transportation sector impacts, (2) electrification may reduce emissions with electricity decarbonization, and (3) higher oil prices may hasten electrification.
articles.abstract_cn: 可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型为预期未来交通部门结构性变化对整体经济的影响提供了宝贵的见解，然而很少有CGE模型提供详细的交通表示。我们使用增强的全球经济应用动态分析（ADAGE）CGE模型，将公路客运和货运中的细分交通方式和技术纳入其中。我们评估了这些纳入对美国交通模式、能源消耗和温室气体排放的影响。通过模拟有无交通细节的说明性全球油价案例，我们发现CGE模型中的子部门方式细分和技术添加显著改变了油价对全球贸易和货运模式、能源消耗以及温室气体（GHG）排放的影响。我们发现：（1）替代技术对于捕捉交通部门影响至关重要，（2）电气化可能随着电力脱碳而减少排放，以及（3）更高的油价可能加速电气化。

articles.title_en: Greening through centralization of environmental monitoring?
articles.title_cn: 通过环境监测的中央集权实现绿色化？
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of China's environmental monitoring centralization on firms' greenwashing practices, by examining the causal relationship between environmental governance at the local level and effective environmental regulations for sustainable growth. Using a difference-in-difference (DID) model, we analyze data from Chinese-listed firms over a period spanning from 2010 to 2019. Our results show that environmental monitoring centralization can significantly reduce greenwashing practices, particularly in cases where there is a high level of environmental decentralization. Furthermore, we find that privately-owned firms with high levels of pollution and technology intensity are particularly motivated to reduce greenwashing practices as environmental decentralization levels increase due to the centralization of environmental monitoring policies. Finally, our study reveals that the centralization of environmental monitoring policy shock can effectively curb greenwashing practices by strengthening environmental regulation levels. These findings provide valuable insights for policymakers seeking to promote sustainable growth through effective environmental regulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过考察地方层面的环境治理与有效环境法规对可持续增长之间的因果关系，研究了中国环境监测中央集权对企业漂绿行为的影响。使用双重差分（DID）模型，我们分析了2010年至2019年间中国上市公司的数据。结果表明，环境监测中央集权可以显著减少漂绿行为，特别是在环境分权程度较高的情况下。此外，我们发现，由于环境监测政策的中央集权，污染和技术密集型高的私营企业随着环境分权水平的增加，特别有动力减少漂绿行为。最后，我们的研究揭示，环境监测政策冲击的中央集权可以通过加强环境监管水平有效遏制漂绿行为。这些发现为政策制定者通过有效环境法规促进可持续增长提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title_en: The hard road to a soft landing: Evidence from a (modestly) nonlinear structural model
articles.title_cn: 通往软着陆的艰难之路：来自一个（适度）非线性结构模型的证据
articles.abstract_en: What drove inflation so high in 2022? Can it drop rapidly without a recession? The Phillips curve is central to the answers; its proper (nonlinear) specification reveals that the relationship is strong and frequency-dependent, and inflation is very persistent. We embed this empirically-successful Phillips curve – incorporating a supply-shocks variable – into a structural model. Identification is achieved using an underutilized data-dependent method. Despite imposing anchored inflation expectations and a rapid relaxation of supply-chain problems, we find that absent a recession, inflation will be >3% by the end of 2025. A simple welfare analysis supports a mild recession as preferred to an extended period of elevated inflation, under a typical loss function.
articles.abstract_cn: 是什么推动通胀在2022年如此之高？它能否在不出现衰退的情况下迅速下降？菲利普斯曲线是回答这些问题的核心；其恰当的（非线性）设定表明，这种关系是强劲且频率依赖的，并且通胀具有很高的持续性。我们将这一经验上成功的菲利普斯曲线——包含一个供给冲击变量——嵌入到一个结构模型中。识别是通过一种未被充分利用的、依赖于数据的方法实现的。尽管设定了锚定的通胀预期和供应链问题的快速缓解，我们发现，如果没有衰退，到2025年底通胀将超过3%。一个简单的福利分析支持，在典型的损失函数下，温和衰退优于长期的高通胀。

articles.title_en: Green innovation downturn: The role of imperfect competition
articles.title_cn: 绿色创新下行：不完全竞争的作用
articles.abstract_en: We use strategic interactions to analyze the role of China’s state-subsidized production expansion in the recent downturn in solar photovoltaics innovation. To that end, we develop a dynamic game model in which N solar panel manufacturers compete in price and invest in cost-reducing research. The resulting Nash equilibrium displays an inverted U relationship between a manufacturer’s market share and its research effort. In the case where a local firm is competing against a foreign state-subsidized one, we obtain analytical and numerical results that are consistent with three stylized facts: (i) the foreign manufacturer progressively expands to become the dominant player, (ii) competition and innovation bring marginal costs down to zero, and (iii) each manufacturer’s research effort follows an increasing-then-decreasing curve. At a policy level, our model shows that national technology-push policies, such as R&D subsidies, can affect foreign innovation by changing the structure of global competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用战略互动来分析中国国家补贴的生产扩张在近期太阳能光伏创新下行中的作用。为此，我们开发了一个动态博弈模型，其中N家太阳能电池板制造商在价格上竞争，并投资于降低成本的研发。由此产生的纳什均衡显示出制造商市场份额与其研发努力之间的倒U型关系。在本地企业与外国国家补贴企业竞争的情况下，我们获得的解析和数值结果与三个典型事实一致：（i）外国制造商逐步扩张成为主导者，（ii）竞争和创新将边际成本降至零，以及（iii）每家制造商的研发努力遵循先增后减的曲线。在政策层面，我们的模型表明，国家技术推动政策，如研发补贴，可以通过改变全球竞争结构来影响外国创新。

articles.title_en: Dynamic time-frequency connectedness between European emissions trading system and sustainability markets
articles.title_cn: 欧洲碳排放交易体系与可持续市场之间的动态时频连通性
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the time-frequency spillovers and connectedness network between European ETS and the sustainability markets. Empirically, we rely on the Baruník and Křehlík (2018) Diebold and Yilmaz (2012) spillover index to measure the time-varying spillovers, directional spillover, net directional spillover and connectedness network in the short-term and long-term investment horizons. Our findings suggest higher overall interconnectedness between the carbon price returns and sustainability indices, with a total spillover index of 69.75%. More specifically, the magnitude of spillovers is substantially higher in the short term than in the long terms. Moreover, European, France, and Germany sustainability indices exhibit the properties of the largest transmitter of spillover of returns towards the system whereas carbon prices are the lowest contributor to transmitting the spillovers towards the system. In the connectedness network, ETS offers a good investment opportunity with Belgium and Finland sustainability indices due to the lower level of returns connectedness. Finally, ETS provides the portfolio risk reduction in the short-term and long-term investment horizons.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了欧洲碳排放交易体系（ETS）与可持续市场之间的时频溢出效应及连通性网络。实证上，我们采用Baruník和Křehlík（2018）以及Diebold和Yilmaz（2012）的溢出指数来衡量短期和长期投资视野下的时变溢出、方向性溢出、净方向性溢出及连通性网络。我们的研究结果表明，碳价格回报与可持续指数之间存在更高的整体互联性，总溢出指数为69.75%。更具体地，短期内的溢出幅度显著高于长期。此外，欧洲、法国和德国的可持续指数表现出向系统传递回报溢出的最大发射者特征，而碳价格则是向系统传递溢出的最低贡献者。在连通性网络中，ETS与比利时和芬兰的可持续指数提供了良好的投资机会，因为它们的回报连通性水平较低。最后，ETS在短期和长期投资视野中提供了投资组合风险降低的作用。

articles.title_en: Impacts of weather conditions on the US commodity markets systemic interdependence across multi-timescales
articles.title_cn: 天气状况对美国大宗商品市场跨多时间尺度系统性相互依存的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study analyses the role of weather conditions in driving the interdependence of the US commodities system comprising energy, agricultural, and metal markets from January 2000 to October 2021. By measuring the commodity markets systemic interdependence through dynamic equicorrelation (DECO), total returns spillover (TRS), upside and downside tail risk spillover (UTRS/DTRS), we investigate the co-vary dynamics between weather conditions and interdependence of commodity system in time-frequency domains. We discover that low temperature level plays a significant role in leading the commodities DECO at 32–64 months time scale. It is shown that high temperature level, global horizontal irradiance, and wind speed acts as an important part in driving TRS at around 64-month time scale. We also find that high temperature level and global warming conditions have a negative leading influence on UTRS at 32–64 months time scale whilst cloud coverage, precipitation and runoff have a positive leading impact on the UTRS at the same time scale. Moreover, temperature is found to lead the change of DTRS at around 64-month time scale persistently throughout the sample period. Through incorporating heterogeneous investment horizons, our findings provide practical implications for commodity investors in adapting to climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了天气状况在驱动美国大宗商品系统（包括能源、农业和金属市场）相互依存中的作用，时间范围从2000年一月至2021年十月。通过动态等相关性（DECO）、总收益溢出（TRS）、上行和下行尾部风险溢出（UTRS/DTRS）来衡量大宗商品市场的系统性相互依存，我们研究了天气状况与大宗商品系统相互依存之间在时频域的协变动态。我们发现，低温水平在32-64个月时间尺度上对大宗商品DECO起显著作用。研究表明，高温水平、全球水平辐照度和风速在约64个月时间尺度上对TRS的驱动起重要作用。我们还发现，高温水平和全球变暖条件在32-64个月时间尺度上对UTRS有负向领先影响，而云量、降水和径流在同一时间尺度上对UTRS有正向领先影响。此外，温度在整个样本期间持续领先DTRS的变化，时间尺度约为64个月。通过纳入异质投资期限，我们的发现为大宗商品投资者适应气候变化提供了实际启示。

articles.title_en: How does green bond issuance affect total factor productivity? Evidence from Chinese listed enterprises
articles.title_cn: 绿色债券发行如何影响全要素生产率？来自中国上市企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: To investigate whether micro issuers can benefit from green bonds, we explore the influence of green bond issuance (GBI) on corporate total factor productivity (TFP) with a staggered DID method from 2015 to 2020. We discover a significantly positive and dynamically persistent relationship between GBI and TFP. Mechanism examinations indicate that GBI increases TFP by reducing the extent of maturity mismatch and lowering financing costs. In addition, the enhancement effect of GBI on TFP tends to be more pronounced for non-state-owned firms, non-heavily polluting ones, and enterprises located in regions with lower financial development. Moreover, whether belonging to green financial reform and innovation pilot zones does not affect the improvement impact of green bond issuance on corporate TFP. Our findings provide theoretical guidance for enterprises to improve their development quality and for the government to optimize and innovate macro policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 为探究微观发行主体能否从绿色债券中获益，我们采用交错双重差分法，基于2015年至2020年的数据，考察了绿色债券发行（GBI）对企业全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。我们发现GBI与TFP之间存在显著正向且动态持续的关系。机制检验表明，GBI通过降低期限错配程度和降低融资成本来提高TFP。此外，GBI对TFP的提升效应在非国有企业、非重污染企业以及位于金融发展水平较低地区的企业中更为显著。而且，是否属于绿色金融改革创新试验区并不影响绿色债券发行对企业TFP的改善作用。我们的研究为企业提升发展质量以及政府优化和创新宏观政策提供了理论指导。

articles.title_en: Role of ESG investments in achieving COP-26 targets
articles.title_cn: ESG投资在实现COP-26目标中的作用
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to evaluate the relationship between Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) and the goals of COP-26 (reduction of greenhouse gas emissions) in China by applying the Autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) bounds testing technique with annual data from to 1990–2021. The main findings confirmed that, in the long term, with a 1% improvement in ESG investment, GHG emissions of greenhouse gases in China will decrease by 0.0046%. Simultaneously, ESG had a negative and significant effect in the short term. With a 1% increase in this variable, China's greenhouse gas emissions will decrease by 1.391%. The recommended practical policies in this study are establishing an ESG-investing network (ESGIN), introduction and implementation of ESG investing law, improving digital ESG investing, and enhancing an ESG-oriented culture in business.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在通过应用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验技术，利用1990-2021年的年度数据，评估环境、社会和治理（ESG）与中国COP-26目标（减少温室气体排放）之间的关系。主要发现证实，长期来看，ESG投资每提高1%，中国的温室气体排放量将减少0.0046%。同时，ESG在短期内具有显著的负向效应。该变量每增加1%，中国的温室气体排放量将减少1.391%。本研究推荐的实际政策包括建立ESG投资网络（ESGIN），引入并实施ESG投资法律，改善数字ESG投资，以及在商业中增强以ESG为导向的文化。

articles.title_en: Does adhering to the principles of green finance matter for stock valuation? Evidence from testing for (co-)explosiveness
articles.title_cn: 遵循绿色金融原则对股票估值是否重要？来自（共同）爆炸性检验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use a test for co-explosiveness to improve our understanding of the effects of green finance on the valuation of stocks. First, by testing against temporary explosiveness in the MVIS Global Coal Index, the NASDAQ OMX Green Economy Index, and the MSCI World Equity Index, we find evidence for explosive periods in the latter two time series. Second, we use a recently proposed econometric procedure to test for co-explosivity of the jointly explosive variables, i.e., the NASDAQ OMX Green Economy Index and the MSCI World Equity Index. The test results indicate co-explosive behavior. The MVIS Global Coal Index, on the other hand, shows completely different time series properties. Assuming that there is no speculative bubble, the theory of corporate finance suggests that this empirical finding should be a result of differences with regard to risk premia demanded by investors buying the respective stocks and (respectively or) expected future corporate earnings of the firms examined here. More specifically, the existence of higher risk premia and pessimistic expectations regarding future corporate earnings should suggest that investors are looking at the business models of firms that are included in the MVIS Global Coal Index with at least a certain degree of skepticism. Thus, our results imply that not adhering to the principles of green finance perhaps might be more important for the stock market valuation of firms than adhering to it.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用共同爆炸性检验来加深对绿色金融对股票估值影响的理解。首先，通过检验MVIS全球煤炭指数、纳斯达克OMX绿色经济指数和MSCI世界股票指数的暂时性爆炸性，我们发现后两个时间序列存在爆炸性时期。其次，我们使用最近提出的计量经济学程序来检验共同爆炸性变量的共同爆炸性，即纳斯达克OMX绿色经济指数和MSCI世界股票指数。检验结果表明存在共同爆炸性行为。另一方面，MVIS全球煤炭指数显示出完全不同的时间序列特性。假设不存在投机泡沫，公司金融理论表明，这一实证发现应是投资者购买相应股票所要求的风险溢价差异以及（或）所考察公司未来预期公司收益差异的结果。更具体地说，较高风险溢价的存在和对未来公司收益的悲观预期应表明，投资者至少以一定程度的怀疑态度看待纳入MVIS全球煤炭指数的公司的商业模式。因此，我们的结果表明，不遵循绿色金融原则可能比遵循这些原则对公司的股票市场估值更为重要。

articles.title_en: Green bonds markets and renewable energy development: Policy integration for achieving carbon neutrality
articles.title_cn: 绿色债券市场与可再生能源发展：实现碳中和的政策整合
articles.abstract_en: Considering the importance of developing renewable energy consumption to reduce the threat of climate change, this study attempts to evaluate the impacts of green bonds and the development of wind, hydro, and solar energy in a sample of 15 member economies of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD). It employs the fully modified OLS (FMOLS) technique based on data from 2010 to 2020. The estimations show that issued green bonds increase wind and hydro-energy consumption in OECD countries. At the same time, green bonds do not significantly impact solar energy deployment in these economies. The central practical integrated policies recommended by this study include developing a digital green bond market, establishing a green bond issuance network (GBIN), implementing an international carbon tax policy, and planning to achieve green economic recovery through the green bond market development.
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑到发展可再生能源消费以减轻气候变化威胁的重要性，本研究试图评估绿色债券以及风能、水能和太阳能发展对经济合作与发展组织（OECD）15个成员国经济体的影响。它采用基于2010年至2020年数据的完全修正普通最小二乘法（FMOLS）技术。估计结果显示，发行的绿色债券增加了OECD国家的风能和水能消费。同时，绿色债券对这些经济体的太阳能部署没有显著影响。本研究推荐的核心实用整合政策包括发展数字绿色债券市场、建立绿色债券发行网络（GBIN）、实施国际碳税政策，以及规划通过绿色债券市场发展实现绿色经济复苏。

articles.title_en: Transregional electricity transmission and carbon emissions: Evidence from ultra-high voltage transmission projects in China
articles.title_cn: 跨区域电力传输与碳排放：来自中国特高压输电工程的证据
articles.abstract_en: Ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission projects provide an effective way to alleviate the reverse distribution of energy in China, but do they reduce regional carbon emissions? This paper takes UHV transmission projects as a quasi-natural experiment and adopts a time-varying difference-in-differences (DID) method to test the effect of trans-regional electricity transmission on carbon emission performance and its transmission path. The empirical results show that (1) UHV transmission projects have significantly reduced the amount and intensity of regional carbon emissions, and this conclusion is still valid after a series of robustness tests. (2) UHV transmission projects can reduce regional carbon emissions by promoting energy substitution, power generation capacity, industrial agglomeration, and output efficiency. (3) The carbon reduction effect of UHV transmission projects is more significant in regions with high energy dependence and regions with clean power generation at power output. The findings of this paper not only enrich the literature on infrastructure investment and carbon emission reduction but also provide an empirical reference for the government to orderly promote the new infrastructure investment direction.
articles.abstract_cn: 特高压输电工程为缓解中国能源逆向分布提供了有效途径，但它们是否减少了区域碳排放？本文将特高压输电工程作为准自然实验，采用时变双重差分法检验跨区域电力传输对碳排放绩效的影响及其传导路径。实证结果表明：（1）特高压输电工程显著降低了区域碳排放量和碳排放强度，这一结论在经过一系列稳健性检验后仍然成立。（2）特高压输电工程可以通过促进能源替代、发电能力、产业集聚和产出效率来减少区域碳排放。（3）特高压输电工程的碳减排效应在能源依赖度高的地区和电力输出端清洁发电的地区更为显著。本文的研究不仅丰富了基础设施投资与碳减排的相关文献，也为政府有序推进新型基础设施投资方向提供了经验参考。
